message: I want a feedback loop where once per day an agent runs and tries to improve how many notes files get added per day. I think we need to start tracking notes files. Create a Notes Files stock.
text:
The Notes Files stock is already declared, and its measurement is recording, so I didn't change anything this turn. The notes-count instrument is still a draft that expires 2026-11-02 at 10:05 UTC unless you say "keep it".

The daily feedback loop is still not set up: I don't have the tools to add a duty or create a scheduled agent here.
